viewOnly.banner: You have view-only access — free circles include two editing caregivers. If you need to make changes, ask {{ownerName}} about upgrading.
viewOnly.bannerShort: View-only — you can see everything, but changes are off.

readOnly.ownerBanner: Your subscription ended, so this circle is view-only for now. Everything is saved — re-subscribe to pick up where you left off.
readOnly.memberBanner: This circle is view-only right now because the owner's subscription ended. Everything is still here to see, and editing comes back if the owner re-subscribes.

circleSelection.banner: Your subscription ended. Choose which circle to keep with free access.
circleSelection.title: Pick one circle to keep
circleSelection.subtitle: Your subscription has ended. Choose which circle to keep with free access. Your other circles will become read-only until you re-subscribe.
circleSelection.confirmMessage: You can only make this choice once — you won't be able to switch which circle stays free. Nothing is deleted: your other circles stay safe in read-only, and re-subscribing anytime restores full access to all of them.
circleSelection.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
